symbols.read: Price is unchanged at 753.66, still pinned below the 758.57 lower pivot, so the rejection that confirmed resistance last read remains intact and the bearish bias holds toward 721.33 with stop 775.89. The bear FVG at 753.71–754.20 that capped price overhead has now cleared from the open FVG list, leaving only the thin bull gap at 749.77–750.00 as near-term support — a mild change that slightly reduces overhead pressure but does not break structure. The 1H trend reads up with the last candle +0.11%, a marginal stall versus the prior +0.68%, consistent with the stalled push noted before. Bias stays bearish; the read only flips bullish on a clean reclaim of 758.57, and the BULLISH regime tag still conflicts with the bearish 4H, keeping combined at HOLD.

Price has recovered to 83,848.21 and the combined regime has upgraded from HOLD to BUY, confirming the neutral-to-constructive lean from the prior read. The bear FVG at 83,762.24–83,771.38 that was capping price has been cleared, with the last 1H candle closing at 83,773.12 above it, while the bull FVG at 83,120.01–83,124.92 remains the sole open support shelf. The short setup stays invalidated and the 77,730.00 objective is off the table unless price loses the 82,227.56 lower pivot. Bias is constructive toward the 86,725.12 upper pivot; invalidation is a clean break below 82,227.56.

Price has pushed to 2,544.73, reclaiming ground above the 2,537.64 stop and clearing the 2,527.57 entry, so the SELL setup stays expired and the short trigger remains lost. The 1H uptrend has firmed to +0.12% while the 4H stays bearish, keeping the combined posture at HOLD with no directional conviction. With no open FVGs and regime still BULLISH, the bias holds neutral-to-bullish toward the 2,734.55 upper pivot. A clean break back below 2,527.57 would be required to re-arm the bearish case toward the 2,320.59 target; holding above it keeps the upside path intact.

Bias stays neutral-to-bullish but unconfirmed: price at 111.60 is still pinned under the bearish FVG at 111.68–111.71, and the 1H trend has flipped up (111.09→111.35, +0.23%) even as the 4H remains bearish and the combined signal holds at HOLD. The pivot map has shifted — 115.26 is now the lower pivot and 122.29 the upper, so 115.26 is the line that matters: a push through it confirms the reversal toward 122.29, while rejection keeps the 4H downtrend alive. The SELL setup (entry 115.26, stop 115.26, target 108.23) is flagged missed, meaning the move toward 108.23 did not trigger from the stated level. Invalidation: a 4H close above 115.26 voids the bearish structure, while failure to hold the 110.20 shelf revives the path to 108.23.

XAGUSD ticked up to 60.94 from 60.82, a marginal gain that leaves the structure unchanged — combined 4H+1H stays HOLD, with the 1H up still capped by a bearish 4H and no level broken, filled, or flipped. The five-zone bull FVG stack from 59.12 to 60.02 remains intact beneath price as support, keeping the pending long sidelined. Bias is unchanged — the long only arms above 61.87 with 61.65 invalidation and 65.24 target, while 58.50 is the downside pivot that re-arms the short with 58.72 invalidation and 55.14 target. Watching stance holds.

The combined 4H+1H signal has flipped from HOLD to BUY, so the alignment the prior read was waiting on has arrived — bias stays constructively long but is now trigger-gated rather than trend-gated. Price has slipped to 4,190.61, below the 4,198.93 stop and further from the 4,207.48 entry, meaning the setup is not yet valid and the last 1H bar's modest +0.10% bounce off 4,186.57 is the only sign of buyers stepping in. The 4,140.87–4,141.58 bullish FVG remains the sole structural cushion below, with the 4,066.53 lower pivot as the next defense. Invalidation is unchanged: a sustained break below 4,198.93 keeps the trade off and exposes the FVG; only a reclaim of 4,207.48 reactivates the long toward 4,348.43.

The short setup at 1.39 remains invalidated — price is still holding at 1.41 above the lower pivot, the 1H trend is up, and the regime is now flagged BULLISH, so the bearish continuation to 1.25 has not triggered. What changed from the prior read: both FVGs have cleared (the bear FVG at 1.4112–1.4157 that capped price overhead and the bull FVG at 1.3972–1.399 below are now gone), removing the immediate overhead barrier and leaving price in clean air between the pivots. The 4H stays bearish and combined signal stays HOLD, so this is still a range, not a resolved trend — 1.39 support versus 1.53 resistance. Holding above 1.39 keeps the long-side reclaim alive toward 1.53; losing 1.39 reopens 1.25 and restores the short case.
